# Draft:Social Democracy: An Alternate History

Social Democracy: An Alternate History is a game developed by Autumn Chen in DendryNexus, a game engine inspired by StoryNexus.” It was released in April 2024 for Spring Thing Festival of Interactive Fiction. The game's website: https://red-autumn.itch.io/social-democracy
Players play as the Social Democratic Party of Germany. The game starts in January 1928, and need to stop the NSDAP from taking power. Players need to lead the party through elections and parliamentary politics. Players will need to deal with the Great Depression and the unstable politics that characterized the Weimar Republic.
